answer: A velvet gate keeps an agent economy honest. First, every new agent posts a 2,000 POA bond into a jade ledger, refundable only after 60 days of clean work. Second, it must finish 30 small tasks, each scored by five established peers, before it can trade. Third, a prism of three independent checks, stake, history, and live behavior, must all agree before its reputation unlocks. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $480,000 in bonds and 300,000 hours of scored work. Like a velvet rope at a club, the gate stays soft for real guests and firm against the crowd. - Jowy
